name: Fiľakovo (Slovakia)
description: Six equal horizontal stripes of yellow, green, white, yellow, green and white, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature F-1/91.
